description: This is a Java source file defining the EntityCache class, which extends AbstractCache to provide caching mechanisms for GenericValue objects keyed by their primary keys (GenericPK) related to entity management in the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: EntityCache
classes.description: A cache class for storing and managing GenericValue entities keyed by their primary keys within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: EntityCache
methods.description: Constructor initializing the cache with a specific delegator name.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a GenericValue from the cache using its primary key.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Stores a GenericValue in the cache, using its primary key.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a cache entry based on an EntityCondition, or a specific primary key or entity.
